'''Sligo Rovers Football Club''' is an Irish professional [[association football|football]] club playing in the [[League of Ireland Premier Division]].<ref name="extratime history">{{cite web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090914084327/http://extratime.ie/squads/8/ |title=SLIGO ROVERS|website=Web.archive.org|date=14 September 2009 |access-date=17 August 2026}}</ref> The club is based in [[Sligo]] in the west of Ireland.

The club was founded in 1928 and have been in the [[League of Ireland]] since 1934. The club is a [[co-operative]] venture, owned by the people of [[Sligo]]. Rovers have played at [[The Showgrounds, Sligo Town|The Showgrounds]] since their inception. In 2013, they won a third [[FAI Cup]] in four years, and also became the [[2012 League of Ireland|2012 Premier Division Champions]], winning the league with two games to spare. In total, they have won three league titles, five FAI Cups and two League Cups."}}
